COACH'S HANDBOOK

You’re on deck.

WASD or arrow keys move the coach. Space jumps. Shift gives you a short dash. Stand beside equipment and press E to pick it up. Walk to a waiting swimmer, or meet a swimmer at either end or beside an outer lane, and press E to hand it over.

Click a swimmer on the deck or their card, then click the water or a lane below. You can also press E beside a waiting swimmer to select them. Keyboard: 1–5 assigns a lane. Select a swimmer who is already swimming and pick another lane to move them mid-workout: they duck under the ropes and keep their progress.

Beginner0.55× · Taking it slow
Intermediate1.0× · Goes with the flow
Pro1.5× · Hates getting stuck
Aqua aerobicsStays put · Group together
DaredevilResort only · Trampoline, never lanes
  • One is solo. Two share. Three swim in a circle. In a circle, fast swimmers get stuck behind slow ones.
  • Fins are physical. Take a pair from the rack with E and deliver it at either end or beside lanes 1 and 3. With no swimmer in reach, E drops the fins. Pick up dropped pairs with E; carry them to another swimmer or use the return button beside the rack.
  • Use chlorine sparingly. Pick up a bucket with E, then press E beside the pool to pour. Too much hurts eyes. Take eye relief to affected swimmers at either end or beside an outer lane.
  • Stomach trouble starts at level 3. Select a 💩 warning tag and Send to locker before its 10-second bar empties. If you miss it, grab the wall skimmer, walk beside the floating mess, and press E to scoop. Empty the net into the waste bin, hang up the skimmer, then add chlorine to reach 40–65. Too much causes red eyes: deliver eye drops.
  • Cramp rescue starts at level 2. Grab any glowing life ring with E and approach the pool to dive automatically. Swim to the cramping swimmer to give them the ring. They climb out, rest, and return to swimming. Collect the ring beside the bench and return it to its hook.
  • Keep the streak. Happy departures build a multiplier. Each shift has its own star targets on the scoreboard.

Coach Cam (optional first-person view)

  • Switch it on in the menu, or press V during a shift. You see the pool through the coach’s eyes, hands and all: whatever you carry is right there in front of you.
  • Click the pool to look around with the mouse (Esc frees the mouse again), or drag to look on touch screens. W / S walk forward and back, A / D step sideways, ← / → turn.
  • With the mouse captured, click acts on whatever the crosshair is on: select a swimmer, then look at a lane and click to send them there. E still uses what is nearby, preferring what you face. The mouse wheel changes the field of view.

Chaos on deck (from level 4)

  • When something goes wrong, a big sign names it and what to do (the first time, it also explains how it works). The glowing marker shows where to go next, or an arrow at the edge of the screen when it is out of view. A draining fuse on the banner shows how long you have. Every save earns a stamp and a cheer.
  • 🐟 Fish Kid. A kid marches in with a bucket and a very big fish. Catch the kid before the edge and press E. Too late? The fish goes in, everybody swims for the walls and runs around screaming. Grab the fish net, dive in and chase the fish down; it darts away, so cut it off. Give it back to the kid and hang the net up.
  • 🐕 Loose Dog. It steals fins and clutter, knocks walkers over and shakes pool water into slippery puddles. Grab the treats, let it follow you, and lead it out through a locker door.
  • 💣 Cannonball Carl. Show him the red card (E) before he reaches the edge and he joins the queue like everyone else. Each cannonball swamps nearby swimmers, knocks goggles loose and floods the deck with puddles until you catch him on dry land.
  • ⚡ Power Outage. When the lights flicker, sprint to the fuse box and reset it. Miss it and the pool goes dark: swimmers bump into each other until you fetch the flashlight and flip the breakers back on.
  • Puddles trip anyone who runs across them, you included. Jump over them or walk around.

Riviera Splash Resort (levels 11–15)

  • Five lanes and a trampoline. Daredevils 🤸 only want the tower: select one and press T (or click the tower). They wait at the stairs until the orange splash zone in lane 5 is empty, then climb, bounce and flip in.
  • Clear the splash lane. While a daredevil waits, lane 5 is closed to new swimmers. Move anyone still in it to another lane before the daredevil’s patience bar runs out.
  • Crash! If they jump while anyone is still in lane 5, the swimmers in the way get hurt, the whole pool freezes and the clock stops. Swim a life ring out to each victim. They climb out and lie on the deck: grab the medical kit and kneel beside each one (E, or click them) to patch them up.

WASD / arrows move · Space jump · Shift dash · E pick up / deliver / assist · 1–5 assign or move lane · T trampoline · V Coach Cam · P / Esc pause · M music. F, C, and R point you toward fins, chlorine, and eye relief; clicking gear or a visitor walks you there. Jump over dropped fins and puddles to avoid slipping. The coach only enters the water on a mission: a life ring for a rescue, or the net for a loose fish.
